notes.content:

Make sure to check it out:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/21575/Tabletop_Wargames/

notes.title: Heroes of Normandie 1.66 Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We are releasing a new patch for Heroes of Normandie today, bringing the game to v.166.
Good news! We are implementing Slitherine’s tournament system, so expect some news about that!


Changelog:
•	Disabled selection of Sticky Bombs for multiplayer games (to prevent issues) 
•	Further tweaks to tournament code
•	Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Heroes of Normandie - 1.60 patch!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

we are releasing the 1.60 update for [b]Heroes of Normandie![/b]

It's quite a big patch as it marks the update to Unity 5. As we announced before, this was a necessary change for updating the game's ranking system.

You can find the changelog down below.


[b]Changelog:[/b]
- Upgraded core engine to Unity 5
- Transferred backend from Parse to new servers
- Some sections in the editor were not working properly
- Fixed some typos in the labels
- Fixed a bug which caused the briefing dialogue to freeze in some cases’
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Heroes of Normandie 1.50 Patch!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are releasing a new patch for Heroes of Normandie today. Hopefully you will enjoy it. There’s a lot of interesting tweaks and changes, and you can read about them in the changelog below!

Changelog:[/b]

1. Added a new language: you can now play HoN in Russian!
2. Added a new RULES section in the game wiki, also available in-game (via the RULES HELP button)
3. Changed the first American campaign into a complete tutorial. Rules like Ambushing, Tripoding and Action Cards are now explained.
4. Action Cards can now be zoomed-in in any section of the game (in the discard phase, for example).
5. Action Cards don’t pop-up anymore when you hover with the mouse cursor. You have to click to bring them up and click again to use them. This improvement was suggested by many players in the forum.
6. Increased the maximum zoom-out distance by adding two new zoom levels.
7. Improved the way Recruitment Options and Tiles are presented in the Purchase section. They are now categorized by DLC.
8. Added a preview of the Panzergrenadiers DLC, as a “Coming Soon” purchase.


Bugfixing:
1. Added a Summary screen at the end of the Tutorial section. 
2. Fixed the victory condition for the Multiplayer Mission “A long way”
3. Fixed a bug in the carry-over mechanism that in some cases blocked the Rogue campaign.
4. Improved the aspect ratio of the units in the Game Editor (some vehicles appeared stretched-out).
5. Fixed a small number of minor bugs.

notes.title: Heroes of Normandie Patch 1.06
notes.content:
Hi guys,

the patch is out now. It includes a number of bug fixes, sorts out the issues with logging in to multiplayer and adds a new play mode. The original dice rolling model is now renamed Iron Man mode. You can turn this on in the options but it is off by default. There is a new random generator that will make it easier for new players to get to grips with the rules before they put themselves at the will of the dice gods! 

1.06 Change Log
* Fixed a bug that prevented the correct display of the leaderboard.
* Fixed a bug that caused the system to call the multiplayer server too often and bring down the servers. It also prevented logging in for some users.
* On the game launcher there is a Settings button. This lets you select your resolution and should resolve any 21:9 resolution issues. 
* Some external game controllers were causing issues and creating odd mouse input commands. We've improved this so less users are affected but let us know if it still affects you. 
* You can now scroll diagonally with the keyboard controls. 
* All skirmish maps are unlocked from the start. 
* Fixed an AI bug that caused the game to lockup/freeze. 
* Fixed a bug in the appearance of the German Fire Unit’
* It now auto saved in skirmish mode 
* added Iron Man Mode, and defaulted to having it off. Players should not experience runs of bad luck as the chance of this happening has been vastly reduced. 

The team are still working hard on a range of improvements so keep your feedback coming. We're especially interested to hear what you think about the new dice rolling system. Enjoy the game!
